obfuscation_indicators: uncertain realizability of deferred tax assets
risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively specific and includes meaningful revenue, loss, liquidity, covenant, and credit-facility figures, but relies on standard forward-looking disclaimers and judgment-based estimates. Risk is elevated by persistent net losses, dependence on new-product growth, lower CSSP margins, expected tablet and mature-product declines, and uncertainty around deferred tax assets, although liquidity and covenant compliance appear adequate at the reporting date.
